> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The round-2 approval remains supported. The complete Retry-After header value is passed unwrapped to a dedicated full-match parser, malformed and non-positive values fail closed to the existing exponential backoff, and accepted values share the established cap. The production call site and sleep path preserve those semantics. The tests are non-vacuous: they separately pin strict grammar, parser delegation and argument shape, zero-delay fallback through the real shared schedule, positive-delay honoring, and the HTTPError production leg. I found no remaining correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue in the diff.
